root_cause: QuantDinger endpoint bug: _build_segments can pass a 20-29 candle trailing segment into _extract_features, which indexes close.iloc[-30].
narrow_fix_scope: External QuantDinger upstream only; no Tenn product-code fix under this card.
summary: The May 24 regime detect failure is not a bad Tenn transport integration. It is an upstream sidecar data-window bug exposed by valid 30+ candle windows that leave a 20-29 candle trailing segment.
